aboutSubheading: Helping Mornington Peninsula homeowners find the perfect balance of light, privacy and style since 2003.
aboutText: Olympic Blinds and Curtains has been proudly serving the Mornington Peninsula and greater South East Melbourne for over 20 years. Our family-owned business specialises in custom-made window coverings — from elegant plantation shutters and designer curtains to the full Luxaflex® range — all professionally measured and installed by our experienced team. We take the time to understand your home and lifestyle, ensuring every product is tailored to suit your space perfectly.

servicesSubheading: From first consultation to final installation, we handle every step of your window covering project with care and precision.
servicesText: Whether you're building new, renovating, or simply refreshing a room, we offer a complete range of window covering solutions. Every product is custom-made to measure and installed by our professional team for a flawless finish.

services.title: Custom Blinds
services.desc: Roller, venetian, vertical and panel glide blinds made to measure for every room in your home.

services.title: Plantation Shutters
services.desc: Timeless timber and PVC plantation shutters that add value, insulation and classic style to any space.

services.title: Curtains & Drapes
services.desc: Designer fabrics crafted into elegant curtains and drapes — from soft sheers to full blockout linings.

services.title: Luxaflex® Range
services.desc: As an authorised Luxaflex® dealer, we offer the full range of premium European window furnishings.

services.title: Motorised Blinds
services.desc: Smart home-compatible motorisation for blinds, curtains and shutters — controlled at the touch of a button.

services.title: Outdoor Blinds
services.desc: Weather-resistant outdoor blinds and awnings to extend your living space all year round.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from homeowners across the Mornington Peninsula and South East Melbourne.

testimonials.text: We had plantation shutters installed throughout our entire home in Mount Eliza and couldn't be happier. The team at Olympic Blinds were professional from start to finish — the measure was spot-on and the installation was quick and tidy. The shutters look absolutely stunning.
testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: After getting three quotes, Olympic Blinds were the most competitive and by far the most helpful. They helped us choose the right Luxaflex roller blinds for our beach house in Rye — they handle the salt air perfectly and still look brand new after two years. Highly recommend!
testimonials.name: David Thornton

testimonials.text: We wanted motorised curtains for our new living room and the team guided us through every option. The installation was seamless and now we can control everything from our phones. The whole experience was so easy — will definitely be using them again for the bedrooms.
testimonials.name: Karen O'Brien
